column1: # RATCHETS.tsv — the two-language ratchet ledger (roadmap WS8.6).
# One line per row. Seven tab-separated fields:
#   row_id  verdict  column  finding  closing_increment  producer_reachable  target
# verdict            PASS (holds, with a right-reason negative twin) | GAP (a ratchet:
#                    the gap is present, in exactly the recorded shape)
#                    | RATIFIED-OUT (a former gap the spec ratified as intended
#                    in its exact shape like a gap, counted as neither PASS nor GAP)
# column             format (a hand-built module measures what the FORMAT carries) |
#                    producer-reachable | v2-decision (never a test row; see below)
# finding            the finding a GAP row evidences (docs/roadmap/two-language-completion-findings.json)
# closing_increment  the roadmap increment(s) that close the finding; `upstream:<sha>`
#                    on a row that tripped when the archived battery was re-measured
#                    at the port and is now a PASS
# producer_reachable yes | no | unknown — `no` on the hand-built-only rows the critic
#                    named (crit.misw11: prophecy places, atomics, the byte-overlap
#                    union model, stable digests): the format carries them, no
# target             the test target that emits the row (b0..b7 = two_language_bN,
# Every target checks a BIJECTION against this file (harness.rs): each row it
# emits appears here exactly once, with its verdict and target, and each line
# naming the target is emitted. Flipping a row means editing its line in the
# fixing commit. The 71 `core-arch-0916-*` lines are the unimplemented v2
# architecture (owner-decision gates WS8.16..WS8.25); they are ledger lines only
# and never enter the format denominator (crit.misw01).
